deadline.value: Computing has four application rounds for April/October 2027 entry: 1 Oct 2026 (already passed), 1 Dec 2026, 1 Feb 2027 and 1 Apr 2027. Overseas applicants who need funding are advised to apply by the October and December deadlines; the President's PhD Scholarship round closes 2 Nov 2026.
deadline.quote: However, we would particularly advise all overseas candidates in the need of funding to apply by the October and December deadlines. | Application deadline (April 2027/October 2027 entry) Notification of acceptance and funding 1 October 2026 15 February 2027 1 December 2026 15 April 2027 1 February 2027 15 June 2027 1 April 2027

also.quote: Applicants who apply by 23:59 (UK time) 2 November 2026 and are awarded a scholarship will be notified by 31 January 2027.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You do not need a supervisor's agreement before applying. Name 3-4 potential supervisors in your application; it goes to suitable academics, and a supervisor may then interview and accept you.
supervisor.quote: Please make sure to include in your application an indication of potential supervisors, we recommend that you list 3-4 supervisors to maximize your chances of being shortlisted for an interview.

also.quote: Please note that we will normally consider your application only after you have formally applied and your application has been received by the Department.

funding.value: More than 80% of Computing PhD students are funded, and the department offers up to 30 fully funded studentships a year to home and overseas students. These are awarded competitively on academic excellence and research potential.
funding.quote: The Department of Computing provides up to 30 fully-funded PhD Studentships for home and overseas students per year, awarded based on academic excellence, research potential, and equality and diversity criteria. | More than 80% of our PhD students receive funding.

entry_route.value: You need a First Class or Distinction master's degree (or equivalent) in a relevant subject, plus a bachelor's normally at 2:1 equivalent or above. Bachelor's-only applicants are not normally considered unless they are outstanding or have strong research or industry experience.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to have a First Class or Distinction Masters level degree, or equivalent, in a relevant scientific or technical discipline, such as computer science or mathematics. | Candidates who have only a Bachelors degree will not normally be considered.

toefl_min.value: Computing requires Imperial's Standard English level: TOEFL iBT 92 overall (min 20 in each section), or 4.5 on the new scale.
toefl_min.quote: Our Computing Research doctoral degree requires that students attain University's English requirements at Standard level.

ielts_min.value: Computing requires Imperial's Standard English level: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall (min 6.0 in each element).
ielts_min.quote: Our Computing Research doctoral degree requires that students attain University's English requirements at Standard level.

app_fee.value: There is currently no application fee.
app_fee.quote: There is at present no application fee.

notes: Apply to the 'Computing Research' degree (the 'AI and Machine Learning' degree is only for the AI4Health CDT). You need a CV, a 1-2 page personal statement and a 3-4 page research statement, written without help from generative AI tools. The 1 Oct 2026 round had already passed when this was checked, so the code shows the next round.
